issues.description: IAM-policy fetch failure silently produces PASS, turning auth errors into clean findings
issues.detail: In _get_images, when getIamPolicy raises (e.g., permission denied as test-image-3 simulates), the image is appended with publicly_shared=False. The check then reports PASS, conflating 'verified non-public' with 'could not verify'. Introduce a tri-state/unknown or surface an explicit error finding so an auth failure is not laundered into a clean bill of health.

issues.description: Check name inconsistency between PR description and shipped artifacts (CHANGELOG/paths/class)
issues.detail: PR description references compute_image_publicly_shared while CHANGELOG, directory, and class use compute_image_not_publicly_shared. The check name is the contract identifier callers, dashboards, and grep-driven maintenance bind to. Pick one and propagate it everywhere before merge.

issues.description: Image listing is serial, inconsistent with __threading_call__ used by every other resource in compute_service.py
issues.detail: Every other collection in this service iterates projects/regions/zones via __threading_call__; _get_images iterates project_ids serially in the constructor. Either match the surrounding style or document a specific technical reason to diverge. As written it reads like the author didn't read the file being edited.

issues.description: Image ADT stores a precomputed verdict boolean instead of the raw bindings/members
issues.detail: publicly_shared bakes one check's verdict into the data model and discards the public_members/bindings that justify it. Storing the raw public principals would let remediation and future checks (role-specific exposure, audit context) reuse the data without service edits, and keeps the abstraction self-describing.

issues.description: Image model lacks self_link/location fields carried by sibling compute ADTs
issues.detail: Disk, Instance, and other models in this service carry self_link/region for addressability. A finding on a shared image with only name+id+project_id is harder to act on across projects/families. Aligning identity fields with the rest of the module avoids one-at-a-time accretion by future maintainers.

issues.description: Service test pins the leaky exception-path behavior, asserting publicly_shared=False for the permission-denied case
issues.detail: compute_service_test.py asserts images[2] (the getIamPolicy-raises case) has publicly_shared=False, conflating 'not shared' with 'fetch failed'. This locks in the silent-PASS behavior and makes the correctness fix above a test-breaking change. Update the test to expect unknown/error semantics.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on two P1 issues: the IAM-policy exception handler silently coerces fetch failures into publicly_shared=False, so auth errors become PASS findings, and the check name disagrees between the PR description and the shipped CHANGELOG/paths/class. Torvalds additionally flags that _get_images is serial while every other resource in compute_service.py uses __threading_call__ — a style break worth fixing. Secondary cleanups: the Image ADT bakes a verdict boolean instead of carrying raw IAM members, it lacks the self_link/location fields its siblings have, and the service test pins the leaky exception-path behavior. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK before merge.
